booking.cancelled_by_user.title: Booking Cancelled
booking.cancelled_by_user.body: Your booking for "{slot_title}" has been cancelled.

booking.cancelled_by_admin.title: Booking Cancelled by Admin
booking.cancelled_by_admin.body: Your booking for "{slot_title}"{task_label} was cancelled by an administrator.{detail}

shift.time_changed.title: Shift Time Changed
shift.time_changed.body: The time for shift "{slot_title}" has been updated. Please check the new schedule.

task.published.title: New Task Published
task.published.body: A new task "{task_name}" has been published. Check it out!

task.manager_added.title: You're now in charge of {task_name} · {event_name}
task.manager_added.body: {actor} put you in charge. You can edit the task and see who has booked.

task.manager_removed.title: No longer in charge of {task_name} · {event_name}
task.manager_removed.body: {actor} took you off this task. You can no longer edit it.

event.cloned.title: Event Set Up
event.cloned.body: “{event_name}” was set up from an existing event.{note}

auth.verify_email.title: Confirm your email address
auth.verify_email.body:
One last step to finish setting up your {project_name} account: confirm that this address belongs to you.

The link expires in {expires_in}. If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

auth.reset_password.title: Reset your password
auth.reset_password.body:
Someone asked to set a new password for your {project_name} account.

The link expires in {expires_in}. If that wasn't you, ignore this email. Your current password stays valid.

email.footer_text: You received this because of your notification settings.
email.action_url_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
email.transactional_footer: You received this email because it was requested for this address. If that wasn't you, no action is needed.
email.in_charge_intro: {actor} put you in charge of “{task_name}” at “{event_name}”.
email.in_charge_can_edit: Change the task's description and details
email.in_charge_can_see: See who is on shift and get in touch with them
email.in_charge_step_down: Doesn't suit you? You can step down on the task's page.
email.invite_footer: You received this e-mail because {inviter} entered your address on {project_name}. If you don't know them, you can ignore it.
email.invite_in_charge_means: Being in charge means you can change the description and see who is on shift.
email.invite_in_charge_means_redeem: Being in charge means you can change the description, see who is on shift and redeem vouchers at {points}.
email.invite_sign_in: Already have an account? {link} with this address and the invitation will be waiting for you.
email.invite_decline: Not for you? Then there's nothing to do. Without your yes you won't be put down for anything.

event.invitation.title: Event Invitation
event.invitation.body: You have been invited to join “{event_name}”.

event.invitation.tasks.title: Invitation to be in charge
event.invitation.tasks.body: {inviter} invited you to “{event_name}” and would like you to be in charge of {tasks}.

event.invitation_accepted.tasks.title: Invitation Accepted
event.invitation_accepted.tasks.body: {name} joined “{event_name}” and is now in charge of {tasks}.

invite.email.title: {inviter} invites you to “{event_name}”
invite.email.body: {inviter} invites you to take part in “{event_name}”. Create an account with this e-mail address and accept, and you're in.

invite.email.tasks.title: {inviter} asks you to take on {tasks}
invite.email.tasks.body: {inviter} asked you to be in charge of {tasks} at “{event_name}”. Create an account with this e-mail address and accept, and you're in and in charge.

event.join_approved.title: You're In
event.join_approved.body: Your request to join “{event_name}” was approved.

event.join_declined.title: Join Request Declined
event.join_declined.body: Your request to join “{event_name}” was declined.

team.join_declined.title: Team Request Declined
team.join_declined.body: Your request to join the team “{team_name}” in “{event_name}” was declined.
